text: dsh-approval-autofocus 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的审批卡自动聚焦插件。它通过浏览器端 DOM 观察器发现待处理的审批卡，并在焦点空闲时把焦点移到卡片详情区域，让用户可以使用审批卡原有的 Enter 和 Esc 键盘操作。它不会抢占终端、对话框或编辑控件的焦点，也支持兼容选择器和生命周期清理，适合希望减少审批时鼠标操作的 DSH 用户；不需要额外配置。

dsh-approval-autofocus focuses pending DSH Web approval cards. A DOM observer moves focus to card details only when focus is idle, leaving terminals and editable controls alone. Enter and Escape remain available, and observation can be cleaned up. No extra configuration is required.

dsh-approval-autofocus 的功能「发现审批详情」：观察页面变化并查找审批卡详情节点；卡片出现后自动定位到可聚焦区域。
dsh-approval-autofocus 的功能「空闲时聚焦」：仅当当前焦点在页面主体、已断开节点或 composer 占位区域时，把焦点移入审批详情。
dsh-approval-autofocus 的功能「保留其他焦点」：检测到终端、对话框或编辑区域拥有焦点时不移动焦点，避免打断用户正在进行的输入。
dsh-approval-autofocus 的功能「停止观察」：通过客户端生命周期 effect 注册清理函数；没有生命周期钩子时可从导出对象调用 dispose 停止观察。

dsh-approval-autofocus README · dsh-approval-autofocus：Make **Enter approve** a pending DSH approval, without clicking the card first.

A tiny, dependency-free client plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) Web / Desktop profiles. Once an approval card appears, focus is already inside it, so:

- `Enter` → **Allow once**
- `Esc` → **Reject**

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-approval-autofocus README · The problem it fixes：DSH's approval card (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-approval`) does bind Enter/Escape — but only when the card already contains `document.activeElement`:

```js
if (event.defaultPrevented || !event.currentTarget.contains(document.activeElement) || ...) return;
```

dsh-approval-autofocus README · The problem it fixes：The card is rendered as a **composer takeover**: the composer it replaces is hidden with `display:none`, so the browser drops focus back to `<body>`, and the card never focuses itself. A plain `Enter` therefore lands nowhere — you have to click the card's text once before the documented "Enter approves / Esc rejects" actually works.

**Without this plugin:** click anywhere on the card's text, then press `Enter`.

dsh-approval-autofocus README · What it does：It watches the DOM and, as soon as an approval card appears, moves focus into the card's detail area — but only when nothing else owns the focus:

| Current focus | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `<body>`, or lost to the composer takeover | focus moves into the card |
| terminal, dialog, any input / contenteditable | **left alone** — focus is never stolen |
dsh-approval-autofocus README · What it does：The card's own behavior is untouched: the Reject button, `Esc`, IME composition handling and the pending-request lock all still work exactly as shipped.
dsh-approval-autofocus README · Safety notes：Approval is a security decision, and this plugin deliberately makes it a one-keystroke action — worth knowing what that means:

dsh-approval-autofocus README · Safety notes：- The plugin **only moves focus**. It never presses keys and never approves anything; `Enter` still has to come from you.
- It only takes focus when focus is otherwise idle (`<body>` or the hidden composer). While you are typing in a terminal, a dialog or any input, it does nothing.
- If a model output ever tries to talk you into pressing `Enter` (prompt injection), the card being pre-focused means a stray `Enter` approves it. If that concerns you, click away — the plugin will not fight you for focus — or disable the plugin.
- The compatibility fallback can never land on the **Allow** button or any other action control: buttons and form controls are excluded from the fallback selector, so a stray `Enter` at worst edits nothing and at most is a no-op inside the card's detail area.
dsh-approval-autofocus README · From a Git repository：Paste the repository URL into the same dialog. There is no hosted repository yet — the archive above is the shipped form.

dsh-approval-autofocus README · Manually, via the profile：Add the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or insert one row in that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: approval-autofocus
      name: dsh-approval-autofocus
```
dsh-approval-autofocus README · Uninstall：Disable or uninstall the bundle on the Plugins page. Nothing outside the plugin's own directory is modified.

dsh-approval-autofocus README · Tests：```
node test/focus.test.mjs
```

Fourteen checks against a hand-written DOM stub (no test framework, no dependencies): focuses on appearance, never focuses twice, reclaims focus lost to the composer takeover, never steals focus from a terminal/dialog/editor, re-focuses a replacement card, stops observing when disposed — with or without a lifecycle hook.

dsh-approval-autofocus README · How it is built：A DSH plugin bundle is a package that declares a Node half (`main`) and a browser half (`dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`). The Node half here is empty — it exists so the profile has a loader row that makes the browser half get served and mounted. The browser half is a plain `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` bundle with no imports.

dsh-approval-autofocus README · Limitations：- It keys off the card's `data-approval-scroll` attribute, with `[data-approval-key] [tabindex="0"]` (excluding buttons and other action controls) as a fallback. If DSH restructures the card, the plugin silently stops working and you are back to "click the card, then press Enter".
- Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. It is an unofficial community plugin, not part of DSH.
- If you deliberately click away from the card, it will not fight you for focus.
